bullets.text: Securing AI Supply Chains - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for robust security in AI application supply chains to mitigate risks.
AI-Driven Threat Detection - **Microsoft** introduces an AI-assisted workflow to enhance detection analysis and close security gaps.
Data Security Index Insights - The latest **Microsoft** report reveals critical priorities for secure AI adoption and data protection.
Celebrating Security Excellence - **Microsoft** honors the 2026 Security Excellence Awards winners for their contributions to cybersecurity.
Empowering Frontier Transformation - **Microsoft** showcases how AI and trust can drive innovation and creativity across industries.
